g.id: STEP 1 - WHAT MAY CARRY A PIPE

g.text: STEP 1 - WHAT MAY CARRY A PIPE

g.id: EXCLUDED - dual carriageway, its untagged twin, a roundabout, a slip road or a dead stub. A dual may be CROSSED at right angles, never followed
STEP 2 - THE MAIN PIPE IS GIVEN, NOT GUESSED

g.text: STEP 2 - THE MAIN PIPE IS GIVEN, NOT GUESSED

g.id: Keep what this area needs, plus the lead to where the legs meet
Read SHP/Main Pipe - the user's drawing
Chambers along it at the Table 12 spacing, plus one where a street meets it square-on
Everything drains to that meeting point, then on to the existing STP
STEP 3 - WHERE A SUBNETWORK JOINS IT

g.text: STEP 3 - WHERE A SUBNETWORK JOINS IT

g.id: So the route search is charged 400 m of route for using one
Every join becomes a chamber that will be DEEP once the whole town drains through it
A crossing of a dual carriageway is charged 2,500 m - it needs trenchless work
Pay the charge, and only cross if it still wins
Capped at the fewest joins that work: 30 here. 28 or fewer costs a pumping station
A branch per street gave far more dead ends than the built network has
DROP it - those houses join the street they came off
and its houses can reach another sewer within 50 m
Runs 1,162 to 543. Typical run 48 m to 105 m
Head starts at the first house gate on that street
Spacing 100 m to DN315, then 120, 150, 200 m
FLAG it for a curved-channel chamber. Never add a chamber to fix it
STEP 6 - SIZE AND LEVEL, SOLVED TOGETHER

g.text: STEP 6 - SIZE AND LEVEL, SOLVED TOGETHER

g.id: Smallest size that works, on the TRUE bore
Flow: properties x 5 people x rate, peaked, plus infiltration
Gradient at least Table 11 and tractive force, at most the 3 m/s cap
ONE gradient per street run, not a new one at every chamber
Hold 1.30 m cover to the crown all along
HARD LIMIT. Pumping station here, rising main sized on pump duty, sewer restarts at cover
ON THIS AREA: never triggered. Zero pumping stations
STEP 7 - CAN EVERY HOUSE DRAIN IN?

g.text: STEP 7 - CAN EVERY HOUSE DRAIN IN?

g.id: Deepen that chamber and solve the whole network again
22 compliance checks. A failure is reported, never exempted
